plan.name: Draft repository checks during init
plan.summary: Extend invariant init and internal/setup to draft .invariant/repository.json deterministically from checkout evidence, discovering Go, Python and TypeScript parts, including nested and mixed repositories, without running repository code, commands or installers and without following links or entering dependency, generated or environment trees. Draft the version 1 paths, ownership, shared inputs, declared current-state documents, agent rules and all six command fields using compatible maintained digest pins and the existing Go, hash-locked pip and npm preparation rules and Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest selector conventions; unknown commands, unsupported or missing locks, incompatible toolchains, ambiguous ownership and an undetectable project remain explicit unresolved items, never not_applicable excuses, and an unresolved-only top-level field keeps such drafts invalid under the unchanged enabled-configuration loader until a person completes them. Recognize only statically understood commands, preserve argument boundaries and check scopes, require formatting checks to fail on differences, reuse the existing pure dependency-admission logic without adding package managers, and prove that complete committed drafts load while incomplete committed drafts do not. Preserve workflow pinning, existing init and modeled-setup behavior and non-overwrite rules, including keeping customized repository configuration even with -force, and print review, completion and base-branch commit guidance plus the need for a gate that runs configured checks before plumbing can be enabled, without changing the gate template or enabling external intake. Update SPEC.md, README.md within its 400-line budget and docs/factory.md for this completed drafting step and the remaining gate/intake limitations, citing D-0105, D-0121, D-0122, D-0294, D-0301 and the existing preparation/native-check decisions; this step's new discovery and drafting decision must be recorded by whoever merges it before the next step because the factory cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727Go
tests.says: Go discovery retains modules and checksums, uses the maintained compatible digest, supplies supported test commands and leaves an unproved formatting check unresolved.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727Python
tests.says: Python discovery recognizes hash-locked requirements in supported filenames and pytest, keeps dependency evidence and reports unknown checks without installing or importing anything.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727Node
tests.says: Both supported npm lock versions and Vitest/Jest scripts yield complete committed contracts with check-only formatting and native one-test selectors.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727Unresolved
tests.says: Missing, floating, malformed and unsupported dependencies, unknown or shell commands, incompatible tools and ambiguous projects produce actionable incomplete drafts that committed-base validation refuses.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727DiscoveryAndOwnership
tests.says: Mixed and nested discovery is deterministic, confines every path, excludes dependencies and generated environments, captures declared documents and rules, and expresses shared configuration ownership.

tests.name: TestRepositoryDraft727NeverExecutes
tests.says: Drafting reads evidence only, invokes no external tool or repository hook, follows no symlink and leaves the checkout unchanged.

tests.name: TestInit727DraftsAndExplains
tests.says: Init drafts repository checks alongside the unchanged pinned workflow, reports unresolved requirements and gives review, base-branch commit and configured-gate guidance for native and modeled repositories.

tests.name: TestInit727KeepsExistingConfiguration
tests.says: Repeated init is byte-stable and preserves edited configuration, even with -force, while clearly reporting that it kept the existing file.

tests.name: TestInit727ConfinesWritesAndRequiresPin
tests.says: Init refuses linked configuration destinations without changing their targets and writes neither workflow nor repository configuration without a valid Invariant commit pin.
